app_description: Free robotics and STEM lessons for learners, teachers and parents. Build robots from cardboard, then learn to code them.
home_intro: Build a real robot from cardboard, sticks and one small motor. Then learn to control it with code.
home_point_offline: Works on basic phones, even offline
about_mission: Robot For All makes robotics and STEM education free for every child and adult, whatever their income, language or school.
about_how_build: Build: make moving robots from cardboard using cranks, gears, levers and linkages, linked to the school syllabus.
about_how_control: Control: add a micro:bit or similar board to make your robot move, stop and light up.
about_how_integrate: Integrate: design complete robot projects that combine everything you have learned.
about_who_body: Learners from Grade 3 upward, teachers, robotics coaches, parents, homeschool families, schools and community centres.
privacy_intro: Robot For All is used by children, so we collect as little as possible. Here is exactly what happens when you use this site.
privacy_collect_none: Nothing about you. There are no accounts, no sign-up forms and no cookies.
privacy_collect_no_tracking: No ads, no tracking and no analytics. We don't load anything from other websites.
privacy_collect_hosting: Our hosting provider (Cloudflare) delivers the pages and may keep basic technical records, such as IP addresses, for a short time to keep the site safe. We don't use these records to identify anyone.
privacy_device_title: What is saved on your phone
privacy_device_body: To work without internet, this site saves its pages, and any lessons you download, in your browser's storage on your own phone. This never leaves your phone.
privacy_device_remove: To remove it, clear this site's data in your browser settings.
privacy_children_body: Children can use every lesson without giving any personal information. If we add accounts later, a parent, guardian or teacher will set them up, and we will update this page first.
privacy_changes_body: If anything here changes, we will update this page before the change happens.
lessons_intro: Hands-on robotics lessons using cheap and recycled materials. Each lesson follows five steps: Predict, Run, Investigate, Modify and Make.
lessons_empty: No lessons are published yet. Check back soon.
lesson_draft_notice: Draft: this lesson has not been reviewed yet.
lesson_adult_help: An adult must help with some steps.
template_print_hint: Print on A4 at 100% ("Actual size"), not "Fit to page". Then check the square on the sheet measures 50 mm. No printer? Use the measurements below to draw the parts with a ruler.
template_check_square: Print at 100% (Actual size). This square must measure 50 mm; if not, change your print settings.
template_key: Cut along solid lines. Fold along dashed lines. Make holes where you see a cross.
slides_hint: Swipe or use the arrow keys to move between slides.
footer_promise: No ads. No tracking. Free for everyone.
footer_licence: Code: MIT licence. Lessons: CC BY-SA 4.0.
notfound_body: We couldn't find that page. It may have moved.
lesson_save_failed: Couldn't save this lesson. Check your connection and try again.
lesson_download_hint: Saves this lesson on this phone so you can use it without internet.
offline_body: This page isn't saved on this phone yet. Pages you have opened before still work without internet.
update_available: A new version of Robot For All is ready.
code_intro: Snap blocks together to make a program. Try it on the screen, then send it to a micro:bit.
code_failed: That didn't work. Check the micro:bit is plugged in and try again, or use Download .hex.
code_no_usb: This browser can't send to a micro:bit directly. Use Download .hex, then copy the file to the MICROBIT drive.
block_on_start_tip: Runs once, when the micro:bit starts.
block_forever_tip: Runs again and again, for as long as the micro:bit is on.
block_motor_tip: Drives a motor through a motor driver on pins P0 and P1.
code_variable_invalid: Use letters, numbers and spaces only (up to 30).
code_saved_here: Programs are saved on this device only. Anyone using this browser can see them.
code_import_failed: That file isn't a Robot For All program.
code_python_intro: This is the MicroPython your blocks make. It is what runs on the micro:bit.
code_edit_python_confirm: Switch this program to typing Python? You can keep changing it as Python, but changes won't turn back into blocks.
code_back_to_blocks_confirm: Use your blocks again? The on-screen micro:bit and Download will use the blocks. Your typed Python is kept as a separate program in My programs.
code_python_mode_note: This program is using typed Python. Tap Blocks to use your blocks again.
code_python_keys: Tab adds an indent. To leave the code box with the keyboard, press Esc, then Tab.
block_strip_init: RGB strip on pin %1 with %2 LEDs
needs_new_microbit: Needs a micro:bit V2, the newer one with a speaker and a microphone.
code_sent: ✓ Sent. Your program is running on the micro:bit.
code_downloaded: ✓ Downloaded. Now copy the file to the MICROBIT drive.
code_clear_python_confirm: Clear all the typed Python and start again?
code_python_copy_name: Your typed Python will be kept as its own program. What should it be called?
code_name_needed: Please type a name for the program.
code_name_taken: You already have a program with that name. Please choose another name.
